information_sign_002 · gap-aware Chamfer + M3C2, both directions

Accuracy / Completeness / F1 (reference-gap-aware) & M3C2 (source↔target)

Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom. Section 0.5 is a live DBSCAN gap-exclusion tuner that updates Section 1 (Accuracy/Completeness/F1) below as soon as any slider changes. Section 2 shows M3C2 on the original (non-density-matched) aligned clouds, in both directions, computed once and independent of the tuner.
⚠ Reference limitation: the reference for this object is incomplete — the LiDAR captured only the upper ~2/3 of the pole height and only one side. All 4 methods show the same pattern: a smooth error gradient along the pole — the top matches the LiDAR almost exactly, while the bottom is systematically farther (25-30 cm+), simply because there is no reference there. This is not a scale/rotation error (alignment is correct); it is limited reference coverage — the missing regions are handled via gap detection, and within the scanned region the numbers are consistent with the other objects. Numbers below are computed as-is.

0. Reference (LiDAR) — NN-spacing distribution

Distance from every point of the cleaned reference to its nearest neighbour in the same cloud — the very spacing from which the voxel/radius for density-matching and M3C2 are derived (radius = 3× median).

0.5. DBSCAN gap tuner

Controls which reconstruction points "far from the reference" are treated as a confirmed gap (excluded) vs. a single outlier (kept and penalised). Move any slider and the exclusion is recomputed for all 4 methods, and the Accuracy/Completeness/F1 panels in Section 1 below update: both the cloud colouring and accuracy%/F1.
When enabled, no far point is excluded as a “gap”: accuracy/F1 are computed over the whole cloud.

1. Accuracy / Completeness / F1 — gap-excluded (reactive to the tuner above), adjustable threshold t

Pipeline: aligned → density-matched (voxel = median NN-spacing of the reference) → gap-exclusion by the current tuner parameters above (only clusters are excluded; single outliers are kept and penalised). Accuracy%/F1 are recomputed exactly (a population-weighted estimate over the true sizes of the "below floor"/ "candidates" groups, since the two were subsampled at different rates — see the code). Completeness% is computed once against the FULL (non-excluded) reconstruction cloud and does not depend on the tuner — mathematically exact for t ≤ far_threshold (for "good" target points the nearest neighbour physically cannot be an excludable gap point, since gap points are by construction farther than far_threshold from ANY target point); for t above far_threshold completeness may be slightly optimistic.
